description: This file defines the AzureStorageOperationOptions class and related validation class for configuring Azure Table Storage operations in Orleans. It includes properties for setting table names, client options, and methods to configure the TableServiceClient with various credential methods, along with validation logic.

classes.name: AzureStorageOperationOptions
classes.description: Class providing configuration options for Azure Storage Table operations, including client setup and validation.

methods.name: ConfigureTableServiceClient
methods.description: Method to configure the TableServiceClient using a connection string, service URI, or callback, with obsolete overloads for different credential types.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Method to validate the current configuration, including table name validation and client setup validation.
